methodology_note: L8W walk-forward; bias_base = non-promo-week directional error; bias_promo = promo-week directional error. Positive = over-forecast. n_obs = clean historical test points available.

TPC.summary: TPC lift overstated by +8.4% on average. Smoothies (+14.2%) and YoGos (+11.7%) show the highest systematic over-forecast on TPC events.
TPC.action: Apply -8 to -14% conservative calibration to Smoothies and YoGos TPC weeks.

BOGO.summary: BOGO lift most overstated of any promo type (+12.1%). Most aggressive over-forecast in Smoothies (+17.3%) and YoGos (+19.8%). Only 22 observations — treat with caution.
BOGO.action: BOGO forecasts should receive the highest conservative tilt: -12 to -20% depending on category.

DWA.summary: DWA lift overstated by +6.2% on average. Moderate bias — smallest of named promo types. Chain-wide events have lower per-store lift variance.
DWA.action: Apply -6% conservative tilt to DWA weeks; -9% for Smoothies/YoGos DWA.

Endcap.summary: Endcap/co-space lift mildly overstated (+3.8%) and is the most reliable promo type. Frozen endcap observations are cleanest.
Endcap.action: Minimal adjustment needed (-3 to -5%); already calibrated via walk-forward.

Launch.summary: Launch week forecasts highly uncertain (analog method only). 18.5% systematic over-forecast observed on comparable launches. New format launches worse than same-format launches.
Launch.action: New SKU launch weeks: apply -18% bias correction + 6% conservative tilt. Flag as 'Low Confidence' in all decision systems.

Baby Snacks.trend: Under-forecast: model is slightly conservative on baseline weeks. No downward correction needed.

Frozen Multiserve.trend: Mild positive baseline bias: model trends ~2% above actual on non-promo weeks.

Smoothies.trend: HIGH baseline over-forecast: model trends +10.6% above actual even in non-promo weeks. Velocity assumptions likely stale.

Kids Snacks.trend: Approximately unbiased on baseline; MAPE driven by high-velocity outliers.

YoGos.trend: Positive baseline bias: YoGos model trends +8.2% high. Apple Berry particularly problematic (+29.3% overall bias).
